when: Use when a disputed technical claim requires both source provenance and mechanism reconstruction.

members.role: Acquire the claim, closest sources, dates, versions, and contradictions.
Test what the artifact actually does and construct a predictive mechanism model.

sequence: Decompose the story into verifiable technical claims.
Collect authoritative documentation, versions, and disputed gaps.
Probe the artifact only where source evidence remains insufficient.
Reconcile documented intent with observed mechanism.

provides: evidence that would change the verdict
